# Authorization table of every HTTP route (QA-012, SEC-009, ARC-008, API-019).
# Reviewed by hand; TestRouteInventoryMatchesAuthorizationTable fails when a
# registered route is missing here, a row is not registered, or a gate
# disagrees with the registration. TestRouteAuthorizationMatrix sends every
# row as anonymous, as a person of no network and as a plain member.
#
# Columns: surface method path gate. method "*" matches any method.
#
# Gates (least principal let through):
#   public    no sign-in needed
#   person    any signed-in person; no network membership needed
#   member    a member of the network in the path (web) or X-Network / only
#             membership (api); status and party rules are the service's
#   reviewer  dispute reviewer or administrator who is not a party
#   admin     network administrator
#   mount     (ops) the API and HTML trees, gated row by row above
#   health    (ops) health and metrics: GET/HEAD only, no network data
#             (OPS-013); /metrics only from metrics-allow ranges
# There is no operator gate: the platform operator acts through the CLI
# only and has no HTTP route (ARC-008).
